note: Conceptual tokens shared by both apps. Each platform maps them to native components (SwiftUI / Material 3) instead of imitating the other.

meaning.deviceEq: Anything stored in the headphones (Sony EQ). Never used for local DSP.
meaning.dspEq: Processing on this computer/phone (advanced EQ). Never used for headphone settings.
meaning.predicted: Curves computed from a model are drawn dashed and labelled 'predicción'.

typography.family: System (SF Pro on Apple, Roboto/system on Android)
typography.numerals: tabular figures for dB, Hz and battery values
